contexts.text: When man is conceived anew... AC 21.
Conception-conceptum- () = all thought.
Conception-conceptus- in the Word = the thought and the production of the heart.
Man has no other conception of his life after death...
They have no other conception of the internal man...
These things are incredible to those who have no other conception of life...
They could not conceive what perception was...
The Lord was conceived from Jehovah... AC 1793. AC 1815. AC 1893. AC 1904:3. AC 3704:7. AC 4065:end. AC 4641. AC 5005. AC 5041. AC 6716:2. AC 6866:2. AC 7058:3. AC 10052:2.
They could have no other conception.
This is the conception of the rational man with everyone.
She conceived () = the first life of the Rational. Conception = the first life. AC 1911.
The Rational was conceived from the internal man, who was Jehovah, as a father...

He who is conceived from Jehovah, has no other internal, that is, has no other soul, than Jehovah. Jehovah, or the Divine essence, cannot be divided, like the soul of a man's father, from which offspring are conceived.
The Lord's internal man was Jehovah, because conceived from Him. AC 1999:5.
Jehovah was in Him, because He was one with Him from the first conception and birth, for He was conceived from Jehovah, and hence His internal was Jehovah.
The Lord's soul was life itself, or the being itself which is Jehovah, for He was conceived from Jehovah...
The Rational, being conceived by the influx of the internal man into the affection of knowledges of the external...
How the Lord's Rational was first conceived and born... (Signified by the conception and birth of Ishmael.)
(Afterwards) the Lord's Divine Rational was conceived and born from the influx of good into truth, thus through truth. (Signified by the conception and birth of Isaac.) AC 2094.

From the heavenly marriage are conceived with man the Intellectual, the Rational, and the Scientific, for without conception from the heavenly marriage, man can never be imbued with understanding, reason, or knowledge.
In the internal sense of the Word nothing but spiritual and celestial things are signified wherever there are mentioned conception, or to conceive, etc. Illustrated.
All the conception of doctrine is from good as a father, and its birth is through truth as a mother.
He was born as a man, but conceived from God.
She conceived, and brought forth (Isaac) () = that it was, and was manifested.
Everyone and everything has its being from conception, and its manifesting from birth, thus, as conception is prior to birth, so is being prior to manifesting.
Nothing ever exists, which has not its conception in order to be, and its birth in order to be manifested.
The Lord's Divine Human was not only conceived from Jehovah, but was also born... AC 2649:2.
Birth, or manifesting, is from the Divine Spiritual; and conception, or being, from the Divine Celestial...
The Divine being of life, or Jehovah, was in the Lord from conception. AC 4571.
Rebekah his woman conceived () = from Divine truth as a mother... To conceive = the first origin of the Divine Natural as from a mother...
In the womb, in the internal sense, = conception. AC 3299.
The case with good and truth is the same as it is with offspring; they are conceived, etc... After conception, the efficient, or conceived seed, begins to produce the effect... AC 3308.
The Divine itself, in which the Lord was from the very conception...

Leah conceived and bare a son () = spiritual conception and birth from the external to the internal... To conceive and bear = to be regenerated; for the man who is being regenerated, is conceived and born anew...

Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son () = reception and acknowledgement. To conceive = reception... For in the spiritual sense, conceptions and births are receptions of truth from good, and thence acknowledgements. AC 3925. AC 3955. AC 3959. AC 3968. AC 4879.
His proprium from conception was what He had from Jehovah His Father, and was Jehovah Himself...
The Lord's Human, after being glorified... cannot be conceived of as human, but as the Divine love in a human form.
(Shuah) conceived and bare a son () = that thence came falsity of the Church. To conceive, and bear = to acknowledge in faith and in act.
She conceived again, and bare a son () = evil.
Seed = the truth of faith, and the conception of it, reception.
Bearing in the belly () = the truth of the Church conceived.
The Voluntary in the Lord... from conception was Divine.
The woman conceived () = the first origin of the Divine law in the Lord's Human. To conceive = the first origin.
Unless a man, as to the spiritual life, is conceived anew... from the Lord, he is damned...
The Lord, from conception, was the Divine love, which therefore was the inmost being of His life...
The truth and good of faith in conception. Signified.
The very Divine good of the Divine love which was in the Lord from conception. Signified.
From the influx and operation of the Divine itself which was in the Lord from conception. Signified.
The being of His life was the Divine itself, for He was conceived from Jehovah, and the being of everyone's life is from him from whom he is conceived.
That the Lord was conceived from Jehovah the Father, and was thus God from conception, is known in the Church.
They had conceived so gross an idea...
The Divine was in the Lord from conception itself. References.
The Lord came into the world in order to... unite the Human to the Divine which was in Him from conception.
His being sent by the Father into the world means that He was conceived from Jehovah the Father.
Except by a Human conceived from Jehovah...
The Father, wherever mentioned, means the Divine which was in the Lord from conception. Illustrated. BE 32:end.

Since man is... a recipient of life, it follows that the conception of a man from his father is not a conception of life, but only a conception of the first and purest form receptible of life... DLove 2.
The nature of the initiament of man from conception. General article.
When He went out of the world, He fully united the Divine truth to the Divine good which was in Him from conception.
Lest the man should leave his wife after conception...
Women have a state of preparation for reception, and thus for conception.
Between the disjoined souls of two married partners, conjunction is effected in an intermediate love, otherwise there would be no conceptions with human beings.
To which there is adjoined the love of conceiving, from the delight of which a wife is prepared for reception.
Wives have one state of love before conception, and another after it up to the birth. General article.
From these Relations an idea of the creation of the universe by God may be conceived, and from conception some birth representing it may be produced.
Regeneration is effected in a manner analogous to that in which man is conceived, carried in the womb, born, and educated. General article.
Man's seed is conceived interiorly in the understanding, and is formed in the will...
Thus conceived the flock near the rods... This is taken from what exists in the conception of human fetuses; for it is known that women, while they are conceiving, and after conception...
Leah conceived and bare a son = spiritual conception and birth. AE 444:11.
The womb = the inmost of marriage love, because there the fetus is conceived...
From the birth... and from conception () = from ultimates to primes.
I will multiply thy sorrow and thy conception... Conception = the reception of the truth which is from good.
1. The Lord conjoins Himself with man in the womb of the mother from the first conception, and forms him. General article.
